positive_control.result: The worker accepts both GCTS clauses and pair obligations between checks without rebuilding.

production_pair_feedback.result: The newly proved pair orbit is asserted before the next in-process check, whose model clears every pair obligation and reaches the triple audit.

interpretation: Bidirectional feedback fixes the architectural failure exposed by blind batching: all nine production checks return exact models, and a newly learned pair orbit steers the very next retained check to a pairwise-complete state. The screen advances by 15 pair and 72 triple constraints. Every model is nevertheless pair- or triple-defective, the finite outer search is unexhausted, and the run proves neither non-tiling nor aperiodicity.
